body: Unlisted behavior change: /converge's backlog now takes up a defect issue already promoted into an open sprint. Before (base): F/skills/converge/SKILL.md 'The backlog' took files with 'status: open or status: verified', and F/scripts/review::cmd_backlog skipped any file whose status was not open/verified, so a defect issue /plan-sprint stamped 'status: promoted' at Terminal was out of every drive/analysis/defects run. Trigger: the owner picks a defect issue into a sprint at Frame; before that sprint closes, the owner runs /converge drive|analysis|defects. Outcome: the run merges, fixes, and the owner list closes the record '--as fixed' (owner-list.md 'Close the issues the run resolved'), against the rule the cheatsheet's Defect issues section states (F/scripts/ok-planner-cheatsheet.md: 'A defect issue picked into a sprint closes as promoted, and sprint certification checks its fix') and the CLAUDE template's 'nothing re-opens the issue' once promoted; the sprint's work item then builds over a fix another run already made, and the archive step's 'issues list --sprint' no longer finds it. Not among B1/B8 (which describe the record read and issue=<id>, not the promoted-record inclusion). Scope: caused by the change.

Work item 2 asks /converge's backlog verb to read the intake through the module with the same membership: open and verified defect issues, a promoted issue excluded. At the base, /plan-sprint Terminal stamped a picked defect issue 'status: promoted', and cmd_backlog took only status open or verified, so a picked issue left the backlog at once. Now Terminal runs 'issues promote', which sets 'sprint' and leaves the computed state 'verified' (scripts/issues::state reads route defect before anything else), and cmd_backlog filters only 'rec["state"] not in BACKLOG_STATES' (scripts/review:938-940) with no test of 'sprint'. body: What the product does: 'issues revise' (plugins/ok/families/ok-planner/scripts/issues:revise) rewrites a routed or ruled record's fields and writes no update message, so the revision never counts as unread on 'issues list --unread' or the dashboard's unread tab. Triage's own revisions of a routed record go through 'issues respond', whose update message does flag them (skills/_shared/artifact-definitions.md: 'Once it has routed an issue, the verifier changes it only through issues respond'; triage.md routes the upstream re-check through respond), so decision triage-answers-owner-messages ('the revision reaches the owner as new analysis') holds for triage. The other shipped caller is /converge's owner list (skills/converge/prompts/owner-list.md), which turns a stuck or left-alone defect issue into a judgment issue with one 'issues revise' (category, route null, recommendation null, problem plus a Stuck in/Left alone in section); the record then reappears through 'waiting on triage' and 'needs ruling', not as unread, and where the owner had ruled it the ruling stands over a silently rewritten problem. Reading A: story see-new-analysis ('new answers or revisions since I last read them') covers every revision of a record the owner has read, whoever writes it, so revise owes an update message (or callers other than triage's first routing owe respond). Reading B: the story and the decision cover triage's analysis only; converge's turn re-files the record into the triage queue, where 'needs ruling' surfaces it, and revise stays a silent agent verb as the sprint's notes ruled ('revise ... refuses ruling, messages').
